Scouting Summary

Common themes

  • Off Spin, averaging 88.0 kph (up to 95.0).
  • Typical length is 4-5m (their good length); median 4.4 m.
  • Stock ball is full on the stumps, hitting the stumps (37% of deliveries).
  • Goes round the wicket 80% of the time against left-handers.
  • Round the wicket he shifts his pitching line from down leg to stumps and brings his length back to 4.5 m.
  • Across an over he holds a fairly consistent length.

Biggest threats

  • Most dangerous length is Full (9 wkts, 3.3% adjusted strike).
  • Danger pitching line: Stumps.
  • Takes 45% of wickets pitching full on the stumps.
  • Beats the bat 1.1% of tracked balls (false-shot 27.1%).
  • Gets you stumped more than most — 18% of his wickets (4.1× the typical rate for this type).
  • 0% of catches are behind the wicket (keeper / slips / gully).

Areas to exploit

  • Concedes most runs pitching full on the stumps (28% of runs).
  • Away from full, the wicket threat drops off — look to score in the less-productive lengths.
  • Most of his runs leak through the leg side (54%) — his main scoring release.
  • Cash in when he goes full down the leg side (economy 3.6, beats the bat only 41%).
